whyResult.answer: Invoice 1042 was escalated because a propose_plan action in the collections seat was evaluated against rule MAX_INSTALLMENTS and its outcome was recorded as escalated [entry:8183a61b-7a7e-4702-8fb0-db21c24fa6c4]. A create_escalation action by code then recorded the escalation under the same rule, with the propose_plan entry among its evidence references [entry:audit:3]. The audit entries do not give the specific installment count or limit that triggered the rule, so the exact reason for exceeding it is unavailable. Separately, another propose_plan action and a send_payment_link action for this invoice were each recorded as allowed under rule IN_BADGE [entry:c0ae998d-6967-4fad-be13-c7ae92e1503e] [entry:7d4516cb-fee0-4972-baf1-8078d68a6df7].
